title: SmartAgri UGM Strengthens Research and Industry Collaboration on Day Two of INAGRITECH 2025

body:
**Jakarta** – The participation of the Smart Agriculture Research Center (SmartAgri) of Universitas Gadjah Mada in the INAGRITECH 2025 exhibition continued with high enthusiasm on the second day of the event, Wednesday (30/7). The activity held at JIEXPO Kemayoran Jakarta created an interactive atmosphere between the SmartAgri team and various attendees, ranging from academics, industry players, to visitors from the international community.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/516-1-img_4926-773x1030.webp)

At the SmartAgri booth located at A303-01, Hall A3, the team showcased a number of leading technologies in the field of precision agriculture, including sensor-based environmental monitoring systems, IoT integration for crop cultivation, and cloud-based software that supports efficiency in agricultural decision-making.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/516-2-img_4918-773x1030.webp)

Various discussions and question-and-answer sessions took place throughout the day between researchers and visitors who were interested in the campus's approach to designing technology based on field needs. This enthusiasm reflected growing public awareness of the importance of technology adoption in the agricultural sector, particularly in the context of adaptation to climate change, resource efficiency, and sustainable production.

One particular highlight on the second day was the professional and compact presentation of the SmartAgri team, made possible by the official dress code support from **PT Cendekia Prima Inovasi**, which also served as the main sponsor. This collaboration strengthened SmartAgri's institutional image as a research unit that is adaptive, professional, and open to cross-sector synergy.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/516-3-img_0771-1-773x1030.webp)

Through the interactions that took place, SmartAgri continues to expand its network of partnerships and create new spaces for collaboration in efforts to promote digital transformation in Indonesia's agricultural sector, particularly in tropical regions.

SmartAgri expresses its gratitude for the support of various parties that made active participation in this event possible, and hopes to continue working together in creating a resilient and sustainable agricultural ecosystem.

original.body:
**Jakarta** – Keikutsertaan Smart Agriculture Research Center (SmartAgri) Universitas Gadjah Mada dalam pameran INAGRITECH 2025 berlanjut dengan antusiasme tinggi pada hari kedua pelaksanaan, Rabu (30/7). Kegiatan yang digelar di JIEXPO Kemayoran Jakarta ini menghadirkan suasana interaktif antara tim SmartAgri dan berbagai pihak yang hadir, mulai dari akademisi, pelaku industri, hingga pengunjung dari kalangan internasional.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/516-1-img_4926-773x1030.webp)

Di booth SmartAgri yang terletak di A303-01, Hall A3, tim menampilkan sejumlah teknologi unggulan dalam bidang pertanian presisi, di antaranya sistem pemantauan lingkungan berbasis sensor, integrasi IoT untuk budidaya tanaman, serta perangkat lunak berbasis cloud yang mendukung efisiensi dalam pengambilan keputusan agrikultur.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/516-2-img_4918-773x1030.webp)

Beragam diskusi dan tanya jawab terjadi sepanjang hari antara tim peneliti dan para pengunjung yang tertarik dengan pendekatan kampus dalam mendesain teknologi berbasis kebutuhan lapangan. Antusiasme ini menunjukkan meningkatnya kesadaran publik terhadap pentingnya adopsi teknologi dalam sektor pertanian, khususnya dalam konteks adaptasi terhadap perubahan iklim, efisiensi sumber daya, dan keberlanjutan produksi.

Salah satu sorotan khusus pada hari kedua adalah tampilan profesional dan kompak dari tim SmartAgri berkat dukungan dresscode resmi dari **PT Cendekia Prima Inovasi** yang juga bertindak sebagai sponsor utama. Kolaborasi ini memperkuat citra kelembagaan SmartAgri sebagai unit riset yang adaptif, profesional, dan terbuka terhadap sinergi lintas sektor.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/516-3-img_0771-1-773x1030.webp)

Melalui interaksi yang terjalin, SmartAgri terus memperluas jaringan kerja sama dan membuka ruang kolaborasi baru dalam upaya mendorong transformasi digital di sektor pertanian Indonesia, khususnya di kawasan tropis.

SmartAgri menyampaikan terima kasih atas dukungan berbagai pihak yang memungkinkan partisipasi aktif dalam ajang ini, serta berharap dapat terus bersinergi dalam menciptakan ekosistem pertanian yang tangguh dan berkelanjutan.
